Group rides in Missouri

11 recurring group rides around Missouri: 6 road, 5 social, 1 gravel. 5 roll on weeknights, 5 on weekends. New to group rides? Start with Big Shark Saturday Mellow Ride in Richmond Heights — it's no-drop, nobody gets left. Want to go fast? Big Shark Long Route Shop Ride runs 16-19 mph tempo.
